item.title: ‘Implausible on the evidence’: Coroner rejects escape theory, rules Beckenridges ‘likely dead’ but boy’s mother adamant ‒ ‘Son, I know you are out there’
item.description: There was no elaborate staging, a coroner says, but Mike Zhao-Beckenridge’s mother is unmoved, even issuing a fresh plea to her son.

item.title: Auckland islands’ petrol pain: Jerry cans, hard choices and $4 fuel
item.description: As petrol prices surge, Waiheke residents and businesses brace for the knock-on cost while Great Barrier faces an even starker reality; no public transport, few alternatives and fuel already well past $4 a litre.

item.title: The Big Read: How rising costs are reshaping New Zealand's regional air links
item.description: Regional airlines are warning key routes are under growing pressure, as rising fuel and operating costs force tough decisions. Westport’s the latest town at risk of losing its only air connection - and it might not be the last.

item.title: Packed test schedule in Australia is ominous for Black Caps quicks
item.description: ANALYSIS: Four tests within 31 days across Australia is bound to test the bodies of NZ’s pace bowlers - and history is not in our favour.

item.title: Hockey stick sickle attack ‘definition of extreme violence’ - Judge
item.description: Man created a weapon from a hockey stick and sickle before attack a Judge described as ‘the definition of extreme violence’.

item.title: ‘We do have a crisis here’: Call to boost cardiology workforce
item.description: A charity wants better cardiac care in Waikato, warning that New Zealand has only one third the number of cardiologists needed.

item.title: Farm goes from brink of sale to booming, with profits doubled
item.description: Three years ago, Jon and Fiona Sherlock were on the brink of selling the family farm — now, they’ve doubled their profitability.

item.title: Waikato tops North Island in economic bounce-back
item.description: Cows and construction are pulling Waikato out of the economic mud, with the region top in the North Island on a key economic measure.

item.title: NZ-born US firm Halter hits US$2b valuation on Peter Thiel-led funding round
item.description: Halter will use the capital on funding towards its expansion in North and South America, and the UK and Ireland.

item.title: Government backs $10m Hamilton Airport runway extension
item.description: A $6.5 million loan will be used to extend the runway by 255 metres, provide more local jobs and allow airlines to divert flights if necessary.
